- .claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:40-45; workflow-templates/.claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:40-45 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The fixer posts its claim comment before syncing Claude assets and checking whether the session loaded the new settings.
  WHY: A newly synced guard for comment writes is not active when the claim is posted, and the later settings check cannot undo that write.
- .ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt:25-35, 154-194, 224-244, 850-856, 951-961 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The manifest omits the added changelog fragment and two documentation files.
  WHY: The manifest drives workspace initialization and set-union conflict resolution, so these omissions leave manifest-derived inventories incomplete; severity differs across reviewers (MAJOR and NIT), and the highest severity is used.
- docs/plans/issue-5259-restart-after-settings-sync-plan.md:42 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The plan documents the ConfigChange payload field as `config_file_path`, but the shipped recorder reads `file_path`.
  WHY: The plan remains in `docs/plans/` as a reference, and an implementer following its incorrect field name could reintroduce ignored ConfigChange events.
- .claude/scripts/loaded_settings_check.py:recorder_wired_at | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `git show` revision path uses only `settings.name`, so a non-default `--settings` path can resolve the wrong file.
  WHY: For non-standard settings paths the helper can report `before_recorder_wired: None` instead of the true wiring state; the cited command flows use the default path, and reviewers differ on the resulting fail-closed impact.
- .claude/settings.json and workflow-templates/.claude/settings.json:SessionStart and ConfigChange entries | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The recorder writes one record per session to `~/.claude/loaded-settings/`, and the record directory grows unboundedly.
  WHY: The reviewer reports no runtime failure and considers the hook wiring and gating sufficient, but notes that records accumulate outside the repository.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md, lines 40-44 and line 47 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The fixer claim is posted before the settings check verifies whether newly synced settings are loaded.
  WHY: A newly synced comment-write guard would not protect the claim, and the later check cannot undo it.
- .claude/scripts/loaded_settings_check.py, `recorder_wired_at` function | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: The `git show` revision path uses only `settings.name`, which can fail to resolve a non-default settings path.
  WHY: The command files use the default `.claude/settings.json`; the reported worst case is `before_recorder_wired: None` instead of the true wiring state, with the fail-closed verdict unchanged.
- .claude/settings.json and workflow-templates/.claude/settings.json, new `SessionStart` and `ConfigChange` entries | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: The recorder writes one record per session to `~/.claude/loaded-settings/`, and the record directory grows unboundedly.
  WHY: The reviewer reports no runtime failure, considers the recorder passive and the check allowlisted and deterministic, and notes that records are outside the repository.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Every AI PR must append every added file path to this sorted manifest" — repository contract restated in `agents.md` and referenced by Copilot review comment entry[10].
  Expected change site: `.ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt`
  Evidence of absence: The manifest diff adds `.claude/hooks/settings_load_recorder.py`, `.claude/scripts/loaded_settings_check.py`, `tests/test_settings_load_recorder.py`, and the two `workflow-templates/.claude/` twins (5 entries across 3 hunks). Three other files this PR adds are absent from the manifest: `changelog.d/5259-verify-loaded-settings-after-asset-sync.md`, `docs/implement-plan/issue-5259-restart-after-settings-sync.md`, and `docs/plans/issue-5259-restart-after-settings-sync-plan.md`. Existing manifest entries confirm that `changelog.d/`, `docs/implement-plan/`, and `docs/plans/` paths are tracked. The manifest is used for workspace initialization and set-union conflict resolution; omission propagates downstream.
  SEVERITY: low
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The base is not the default branch, so the issue is closed explicitly." — PR description line 7; restated in the progress log at `docs/implement-plan/issue-5259-restart-after-settings-sync.md` line 71: "#5259 must be closed explicitly once #5283 merges"
  Expected change site: A recorded mechanism in the progress log's post-merge handoff, the PR body, a workflow step, or a documented operator action that designates who or what closes issue #5259 after PR #5283 auto-merges into the non-default `claude/implement-plan-issue-4952-sync-claude-assets-at-session-start` branch.
  Evidence of absence: PR #5283 uses `Refs #5259` (not `Fixes #5259`), so GitHub auto-close does not fire on merge. `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:453-463` gates the standalone close-merged-issues sweep on `[ "${PR_BASE_REF}" = "main" ]`; PR #5283's base is the #4952 project branch, not `main`. The single-issue shortcut (operator Q30/Q33) skipped the completion PR and final-merge stage that would normally close the issue in Issue Mode. The progress log at line 39 records "## Completion — Skipped by operator decision Q30/Q33: no completion PR", and line 89 records "no stage session resumes this chain; review hand-offs on #5283 go to a fresh `/fix-claude-pr` fixer." CLAUDE.md §26.D's hand-back on merge writes a terminal report but does not close the linked issue. The log at line 71 defers the close to "the master session" but no diff hunk, log entry, PR-body text, or workflow step names the concrete actor, step, or trigger that performs the explicit close. Issue #5259 will remain open with `ai:security` after the security fix lands, breaking security-audit followup tracking.
  SEVERITY: high
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: The plan document's Approach item 1 (line 42) must describe the shipped recorder's payload contract accurately.
  Expected change site: `docs/plans/issue-5259-restart-after-settings-sync-plan.md`, line 42.
  Evidence of absence: Line 42 reads "hashes `.claude/settings.json` (the `config_file_path` of a `ConfigChange`; `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR`, else the payload `cwd`, for SessionStart; `absent` when the file is missing)". The shipped recorder at `.claude/hooks/settings_load_recorder.py:89` reads `payload.get("file_path")`, not `config_file_path`. The recorder's docstring correctly says "the payload names the changed file in `file_path`". The contract test `test_config_change_replaces_the_record` uses `file_path`, and `test_config_change_reads_only_the_documented_payload_fields` verifies that `config_file_path` does not work. The fix for the wrong-field-name bug (PR #5283 review round 1 finding) was applied to the implementation but the plan was never updated. The plan remains in `docs/plans/` (not moved to `docs/completed/` due to the single-issue shortcut), so it is the standing reference for contributors tracing the recorder contract.
  SEVERITY: low
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- `.ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt`, lines 850-856, 951-961 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The workspace source manifest omits three added documentation and changelog files.
  WHY: Omitting them causes manifest divergence and prevents them from being tracked in manifest-derived workspace inventories or preserved during set-union conflict resolution.
- `docs/plans/issue-5259-restart-after-settings-sync-plan.md`, line 42 (Approach item 1) | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The plan says the recorder uses the ConfigChange field `config_file_path`, but the shipped recorder reads `file_path`.
  WHY: The retained plan misdocuments the payload contract, so an implementation following it could use `config_file_path` and reintroduce ignored ConfigChange events.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The base is not the default branch, so the issue is closed explicitly."
  Expected change site: `docs/implement-plan/issue-5259-restart-after-settings-sync.md` (post-merge handoff / Notes) or PR description
  Evidence of absence: PR #5283 targets `claude/implement-plan-issue-4952-sync-claude-assets-at-session-start` (a non-default branch) and links issue #5259 using `Refs #5259` rather than an auto-closing keyword. GitHub auto-close only applies to default branch merges, and `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:453-463` explicitly leaves standalone issues open when `PR_BASE_REF` is not main. The single-issue shortcut (operator decisions Q30/Q33) skipped the completion PR and final-merge stage (which normally performs explicit issue closure in issue mode), and line 89 of the log states "no stage session resumes this chain". While line 71 of the log notes that #5259 must be closed explicitly once #5283 merges, neither the PR diff nor the progress log designates an automated workflow step, stage session, or designated actor/procedure responsible for closing issue #5259 once PR #5283 merges, leaving the issue open with `ai:security` indefinitely.
  SEVERITY: high
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
